layout: Fourteen individual transparent pose images. Eleven standard front-enemy states plus flap, burning-flap and poison-flap. Idle/run alternate raised/lowered wings at 280 ms with pose-token cleanup and reduced-motion support. CSS adds hover and corpse fall; the legacy bite filename contains the diving talon attack.

prompts.prompt: Create NEW GLASFORST / GLASS FOREST battle arena for dark fantasy RPG DarkReturn. Attached panorama is ONLY rendering style, front battle camera perspective and framing reference. Match polished detailed painterly semi-realistic game art, very wide panoramic approximately 2.46:1, 1967x800. Environment: ancient petrified grove of BLACK GLASS trees with angular trunks and crystalline branches, deep layered forest receding into cool teal mist, sharp translucent pale aqua crystal growths catching light on tree edges. Quiet mysterious turquoise light between trunks, subtle prismatic reflections, small shattered glass chips at edges. Large gnarled glass trees frame BOTH SIDES, detailed foreground corners. Crucial composition: lower 55 percent mostly EMPTY FLAT continuous dark glass-and-earth clearing, readable open combat ground for three flying monsters; horizon near 45 percent height. No dense crystals or obstacles in central arena, no lava, swamp or snow, no floating islands. Black glass with cool gray, teal and pale green highlights; dark fantasy but readable atmosphere and ground. No characters, monsters, text, UI or border. Fill entire panorama.

Create NEW creature SCHERBENSCHWINGE / SHARDWING for dark fantasy RPG DarkReturn. Attached creature is ONLY a polished semi-realistic rendering-quality and FRONT CAMERA reference, NOT anatomy or design. A flying crystalline BIRD OF PREY made of BLACK GLASS: compact angular owl-like head with TWO luminous teal eyes and a sharp hooked glass BEAK (no mammal jaw), charcoal prismatic chest with small teal core, TWO broad bird wings composed of layered razor-sharp translucent aqua/black glass shard FEATHERS, TWO small taloned bird feet tucked beneath body in flight, short fanned tail of crystal blades. No fur, wolf face, humanoid arms, bat membranes, clothing or weapons. Fierce guardian of a black glass forest, elegant threatening silhouette; crisp reflective facets and slightly translucent pale teal crystal edges, fine detail matching reference quality. Full FRONT view, symmetrical hovering pose, wings lifted outward/upward in a shallow V. COMPOSITION FOR ANIMATION: square 1254x1254 canvas, beak/head centered near x50 y38 percent, chest center x50 y53, tucked talons around y73, tail around y80. Wing tips occupy central 88 percent width, top around y8, generous empty transparent space below creature to show flight. Entire bird, wings, tail and claws visible with clear margins. No floor, ground shadow, scenery, disconnected shards, text or UI. Genuine transparent alpha.
